dct_description_sm: This dataset provides a summary of basic meteorological variables throughout the Leg 1 of ArcticNet cruise of 2015.  The purpose of these measurements is to provide part of the physical context for the various atmospheric, oceanographic, chemical and biological processes which were examined by the various investigators involved in the ArcticNet study.
dct_subject_sm: Geographic locations -> Gulf of St. Lawrence
dct_title_s: Ship-Based Meteorological Data, 2015 ArcticNet, Leg 1, Labrador Sea
